text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both holding steady with minimal daily losses, suggesting cautious consolidation near current levels. The Fear & Greed index has shifted into greed territory and climbed 9 points over a week, indicating rising investor optimism despite the flat price action. Bitcoin dominance at 59.2% with $71B in daily volume shows the market remains healthy and distributed, though the modest declines across altcoins like BNB hint that gains are concentrating in the major two rather than broadening out.
